qs: 大文：妈妈，下课以后我可以去

大文：妈妈，吃晚饭以后我可以吃
大文妈妈：吃晚饭以后你可以吃
dialogue: mā ma, nǐ yào qù nǎ lǐ?
我要去附近的超级市场买东西，你要跟我一起去吗？
I am going to the nearby supermarket to buy things. Do you want to come with me?
wǒ yào qù fù jìn de chāo jí shì chǎng mǎi dōng xi, nǐ yào gēn wǒ yì qǐ qù ma?
要，我想去买巧克力冰淇淋。你今天要买什么？
Yes, I want to buy chocolate ice cream. What are you buying today?
yào, wǒ xiǎng qù mǎi qiǎo kè lì bīng qí lín. nǐ jīn tiān yào mǎi shén me?
我今天要买鱼、牛肉、青菜，还要买米。
Today I want to buy fish, beef, vegetables, and rice.
wǒ jīn tiān yào mǎi yú, niú ròu, qīng cài, hái yào mǎi mǐ.
wǒ yě kě yǐ mǎi táng guǒ ma?
Let’s go and have a look!
wǒ men qù kàn yí xià ba!

reading.title: Reading Comprehension · 阅读理解
reading.instruction: Read Dongming’s original letter to Santa and answer the workbook question.
date: shí èr yuè èr shí hào
passage: shèng dàn lǎo rén, nǐ hǎo!
我是东明，今年八岁，我最喜欢跟妈妈一起去打球。
wǒ shì dōng míng, jīn nián bā suì, wǒ zuì xǐ huan gēn mā ma yì qǐ qù dǎ qiú.
I am Dongming, eight years old. I like playing ball with my mom most.
我也常常跟爸爸、妈妈去超级市场买东西。
wǒ yě cháng cháng gēn bà ba, mā ma qù chāo jí shì chǎng mǎi dōng xi.
I also often go shopping at the supermarket with Mom and Dad.
今年的圣诞节我要玩具、漫画书，还要糖果。
jīn nián de shèng dàn jié wǒ yào wán jù, màn huà shū, hái yào táng guǒ.
This Christmas I want toys, comic books, and candy.

prompt: dōng míng zuì xǐ huan zuò shén me?
What does Dongming like doing most?
options: gēn bà ba yì qǐ kàn shū
gēn mā ma yì qǐ mǎi dōng xi
gēn mā ma yì qǐ dǎ qiú
gēn mā ma yì qǐ kàn diàn shì
